key_insight: Simulations suggest parameterized annealing-scheduled QAOA (PAQ-QAOA) can approximate restricted Boltzmann machine sampling for tractable problem instances.
engineering_relevance: QAOA-assisted sampling could support RBM training, but practical value depends on circuit-depth requirements and hardware performance.
method: Simulate QAOA-assisted Boltzmann sampling with Qiskit Aer.
Evaluate parameterized annealing-scheduled QAOA on tractable instances.
Analyze the sampled distribution’s inverse effective temperature, κ.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports numerical evidence from Qiskit Aer simulations, not quantum hardware experiments or demonstrated scaling advantages.
watch_item: Circuit-depth requirements for larger problems and performance on quantum hardware remain unresolved.
paper_title: $κ$-Parametrized Boltzmann Distribution Sampling on Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm
